threat.confidentiality.passive-message-d.title: Passive message disclosure
threat.confidentiality.passive-message-d.definition: An observer obtains protected message content from an exposed communication representation.
preconditions: Protected content is present on a path observable in a representation that exposes it.
assumptions: The selected capability and precondition are both present within the explicitly evaluated scope.
exclusions: This entry does not assert likelihood, severity, exploitability, vulnerability confirmation, mitigation, or product impact outside the bounded statement.
threat.confidentiality.passive-message-d.impact: Scoped message content becomes available to an unintended observer.

threat.integrity.in-transit-modification.title: In-transit message modification
threat.integrity.in-transit-modification.definition: An active path attacker alters protected input before receiver processing.
preconditions: The receiver processes data delivered through the attacker-controlled path.
assumptions: The selected capability and precondition are both present within the explicitly evaluated scope.
exclusions: This entry does not assert likelihood, severity, exploitability, vulnerability confirmation, mitigation, or product impact outside the bounded statement.
threat.integrity.in-transit-modification.impact: The receiver may act on content different from the sender-intended content.

threat.authentication.sender-impersonati.title: Sender impersonation
threat.authentication.sender-impersonati.definition: An attacker causes a message to be accepted under another sender identity.
preconditions: The receiver relies on a sender assertion affected by injected input or scoped secret compromise.
assumptions: The selected capability and precondition are both present within the explicitly evaluated scope.
exclusions: This entry does not assert likelihood, severity, exploitability, vulnerability confirmation, mitigation, or product impact outside the bounded statement.
threat.authentication.sender-impersonati.impact: A message may be attributed to the wrong sender.

threat.binding.identity-session-misbindi.title: Identity or session misbinding
threat.binding.identity-session-misbindi.definition: An authenticated identity or message is associated with the wrong session instance.
preconditions: Two or more identities or sessions can be confused at a binding boundary.
assumptions: The selected capability and precondition are both present within the explicitly evaluated scope.
exclusions: This entry does not assert likelihood, severity, exploitability, vulnerability confirmation, mitigation, or product impact outside the bounded statement.
threat.binding.identity-session-misbindi.impact: A valid assertion may authorize or affect the wrong scoped session.

threat.replay-ordering.replay-accepted.title: Replay accepted as new
threat.replay-ordering.replay-accepted.definition: Previously accepted input is reintroduced and treated as a new authorized event.
preconditions: The receiver cannot distinguish the captured instance from a new acceptable instance.
assumptions: The selected capability and precondition are both present within the explicitly evaluated scope.
exclusions: This entry does not assert likelihood, severity, exploitability, vulnerability confirmation, mitigation, or product impact outside the bounded statement.
threat.replay-ordering.replay-accepted.impact: A scoped action or state transition may be repeated.

threat.randomness.nonce-reuse.title: Nonce reuse within a prohibited scope
threat.randomness.nonce-reuse.definition: A value required to be unique is repeated under the same scoped key and context.
preconditions: Nonce state can repeat or be restored without detection.
assumptions: The selected capability and precondition are both present within the explicitly evaluated scope.
exclusions: This entry does not assert likelihood, severity, exploitability, vulnerability confirmation, mitigation, or product impact outside the bounded statement.
threat.randomness.nonce-reuse.impact: Security assumptions tied to scoped nonce uniqueness may no longer hold.

threat.key-management.derivation-context.title: Key-derivation context collision
threat.key-management.derivation-context.definition: Derived material for distinct purposes is produced under an indistinguishable context.
preconditions: Purpose or context labels can collide or be omitted at the derivation boundary.
assumptions: The selected capability and precondition are both present within the explicitly evaluated scope.
exclusions: This entry does not assert likelihood, severity, exploitability, vulnerability confirmation, mitigation, or product impact outside the bounded statement.
threat.key-management.derivation-context.impact: Derived material may be accepted for an unintended purpose or domain.

threat.downgrade-agility.silent-downgrad.title: Silent downgrade
threat.downgrade-agility.silent-downgrad.definition: An attacker causes selection of a less protective option without an authenticated policy decision.
preconditions: Choice negotiation or configuration can be modified without binding to policy and transcript.
assumptions: The selected capability and precondition are both present within the explicitly evaluated scope.
exclusions: This entry does not assert likelihood, severity, exploitability, vulnerability confirmation, mitigation, or product impact outside the bounded statement.
threat.downgrade-agility.silent-downgrad.impact: The communication may operate under protections outside the intended policy.

threat.compromise-recovery.historical-ex.title: Historical exposure after long-term compromise
threat.compromise-recovery.historical-ex.definition: Compromise of current long-term material reveals protected content from an earlier scoped period.
preconditions: Historical communication and current long-term material are both available to the attacker.
assumptions: The selected capability and precondition are both present within the explicitly evaluated scope.
exclusions: This entry does not assert likelihood, severity, exploitability, vulnerability confirmation, mitigation, or product impact outside the bounded statement.
threat.compromise-recovery.historical-ex.impact: Past scoped message content may become recoverable.

threat.metadata-privacy.traffic-relation.title: Traffic relationship inference
threat.metadata-privacy.traffic-relation.definition: An observer infers communicating parties, relationships, or activity from exposed metadata.
preconditions: Relevant routing, identity, direction, or frequency metadata is observable.

threat.metadata-privacy.traffic-relation.impact: Scoped relationship or activity information may be disclosed.

threat.resilience.resource-exhaustion.title: Resource exhaustion
threat.resilience.resource-exhaustion.definition: Attacker-controlled requests or data consume bounded resources needed for authorized communication.
preconditions: An exposed interface consumes material resources before enforcing a suitable bound.

threat.evidence-publication.private-evid.title: Private evidence disclosure
threat.evidence-publication.private-evid.definition: Private evidence is placed into a public or unauthorized publication channel.

threat.evidence-publication.private-evid.impact: Private scoped evidence may become publicly or broadly accessible.
